definitions.headline_pretax: hotel_info prices.price (Google nightly base price, pre-tax), USD, 2 adults
definitions.cheapest_refundable_pretax: min prices.items[].price where free_cancellation_until is set (seller-row level, pre-tax); rows with no flagged seller are excluded from this median
definitions.incl_tax: hotel_searches items[].prices.price (nightly incl. taxes+fees; resort fees appear excluded), matched by hotel_identifier to priced list rows; one depth-54 search per cell (3-5 star, most_reviewed) so only a subset of the 50 match
definitions.sold_out: PROXY: requested dates echoed back with no price and no seller rows. The API has no explicit sold-out flag
definitions.no_price: dates echoed back, no headline price, but seller rows present (or prices object empty)
definitions.date_mismatch: returned prices.check_in/out differ from the request (or a price came back with no dates); rejected
